Other interests

  • Writing
  • Phone photography

My other interests are phone photography and writing. I wouldn't regard myself as a photographer or a writer per se but I find both highly enjoyable and they excite different parts of my creative brain.

Writing

I love to write, I've written 1000s and 1000s of words over the years. I even wrote a rather odd sci-fi (speculative fiction) novel for NaNoWriMo a few years ago.

I wrote and published a travelogue on Medium about a trip I took in 2018 to Europe (pre-Brexit when, you know, I still could on my EU passport).

I've written screenplays (sometimes very loosely to allow the direction and action to have more of a free flow) for a few short films and the outlines for story-based music videos.

I have a couple of unfilmed screenplays sitting around so if you'd be interested in a film collaboration then talk to me, happy to share them with you.

Phone photography

A phone camera is one of my favourite inventions of the 20th century.

I walk most mornings and love spotting interesting things to photograph. I like seeing the abstract in the daily and familiar, and how light plays on different surfaces.

Sometimes though, I just like taking pretty photos.
